title: Conditional κ = 0.001677380107853623: idle rank-48 axis reassignments with simultaneous swaps toward rank 51 on #1305's four cold kernels
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001677380107853623**. Extends #1305's multi-donor idle exchange to simultaneous axis reassignments (swaps) inside each replica/port group: rank-48 idle children exchange axes so that the 4-child groups reach (51,51,51,39) instead of (51,51,48,42), 3-child groups (51,51,42), and (51,51,45,45)/(51,48,45)/(51,45) as before. Idle H48=11374 becomes H39=1530, H42=244, H45=1477, H48=1568, H51=6555 with every group's axis multiset, owners, dispatch and native words unchanged. The frozen move list (SWAP-MOVES.json.gz, found by an exact CP-SAT search) is not trusted: verify_idle_overlay.py recomputes every legality condition from the final axis lists (moved axes commute with all stage X/Y, terminal Y and src/dst translations; every final child orthonormal and independent, rank at most 51; group axis multiset unchanged; X2 family disjointness), seven illegal-swap controls are rejected, and check_emitted_operator.py proves exact equality of the emitted per-port operator (T and the Z4 phase form, chronology included) with direct evaluations; then the overlay-aware audit, invoice, strict assembly, 114 admission and 12 bit controls.
